fit_reason: Whole car, 2012 Ford Focus hatchback, listed by a private seller.
findings: Hazy, yellowed lens on the passenger-side headlight
Dull, dirty white paint across the hood and front bumper
Grime and dirt film along the lower rear bumper and rocker panels
Scuffs on the lower front bumper lip
Dirt and discoloration along the bottom edge of the liftgate under the badges
Loose items left in the cabin, a water bottle on the passenger seat and clutter in the door pocket
Dust on the dash and center console
message: Hi, we saw your Focus listed on Marketplace. The headlights look hazy and the white paint has some grime and dullness on the hood, bumpers and lower liftgate. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a buff, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
